description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff development and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and staff. You will play a key role in shaping our clinical team's capabilities and maintaining a healthy environment.

As the SDC/Infection Control Nurse, you will be responsible for coordinating staff education and training programs, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and implementing effective infection control strategies. Your expertise will be crucial in developing and delivering educational content, conducting surveillance, and promoting best practices across the facility.

This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00 per hour. If you are a proactive and knowledgeable Registered Nurse passionate about staff development and infection control, we encourage you to apply and become a valued member of our team.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license.
Experience in staff development, education, or training.
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices.
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations.
salaryOrBonusInfo: This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00 per hour.

description:
Join a dynamic team as a Marketing Director at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This is an exciting opportunity to lead marketing initiatives for a recently acquired facility, playing a pivotal role in its growth and success. We are seeking a proactive and results-oriented professional who is eager to make a significant impact.

In this key leadership position, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive marketing strategies to enhance the facility's presence, build strong community relationships, and drive census growth. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with a proven track record in healthcare marketing, capable of representing the facility with professionalism and enthusiasm.

This role offers competitive compensation for the right individual, reflecting the importance of this position. While primarily Monday-Friday, the role requires flexibility to work occasional weekends to support community events and outreach efforts. If you are a driven marketing leader looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or healthcare environment
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute effective marketing strategies
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a professional and presentable demeanor
Willingness and flexibility to work occasional weekends as needed
A proactive, results-driven approach to achieving census and marketing goals
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated and compassionate Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical PRN role offers the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life while making a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being. You will be an essential part of a multidisciplinary team, providing high-quality speech and language therapy services to residents.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an SLP looking for a flexible schedule with competitive compensation. We offer an attractive hourly rate of $38.00 - $49.00, along with a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus to support your transition. Join a facility committed to clinical excellence and patient-centered care, where your expertise will be highly valued.
requirements: Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology from an accredited program
Current and valid Florida state licensure as a Speech Language Pathologist
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) from the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association (ASHA)
Experience working in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility preferred

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist (PT) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN opportunity allows for flexibility while providing essential therapeutic services to patients, helping them regain mobility and improve their quality of life. You will work within a supportive environment focused on patient-centered care and professional growth.

As a Physical Therapist, you will play a crucial role in assessing, planning, and implementing individualized treatment programs. This position offers competitive hourly compensation and the chance to make a significant impact on the well-being of our residents. If you are passionate about rehabilitation and looking for a flexible role, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist (PT) license in Florida
Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) degree from an accredited program
Minimum of 1 year of experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate for Physical Therapists ranging from $39.00 to $40.00 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.
